thread:
Sam: Kicking off probation bring-up for v2.1-int4. Proposal: fractional ramp by user_cohort (0.5% -> 2% -> 10%) but keep a 'probation window' per cohort (45m) where we only collect telemetry and don't further expand if any signal crosses. Thoughts?
Priya: I like cohort-level ramps. What's our abort criteria?
Sam: Abort if any of: token_error_rate delta > 0.5ppt, token_fidelity_drop > 0.8%, latency_p95_ratio > 1.20, or concordance_heatmap top-3 divergence > 4%.
Lee: Add token-level delta smoothing so transient spikes don't abort immediately. e.g., require moving average over 5m and 3 consecutive windows.
Sam: yep, smoothing + probation = stability_buffer. Also add deadman: if infra-bgutil < 0.7 then global hold and rollback.
infra-bot: system: applied hold to cohort promo-cohort-42 at 1775004300 due to latency_p95 spike (+45%).
Priya: For A/B, let's run pairwise rerank concordance and a small factual-check eval (eval-job/token-contrast-2026-03). We'll also compute token-level attribution for hallucination-triggers.
Sam: Draft rollout snippet:
```json
{
  "fractional_ramp": [0.5,2,10],
  "probation_minutes": 45,
  "expand_after_requests": 8000,
  "abort_criteria": {
    "token_error_pp": 0.5,
    "token_fidelity_pct": 0.8,
    "latency_p95_ratio": 1.2,
    "concordance_top3_delta_pct": 4.0
  },
  "smoothing_windows_min": 5,
  "deadman_bgutil_threshold": 0.7
}
```
Lee: Can you include per-cohort shadowing? I want an offline concordance heatmap and a daily drift digest.
Sam: Will add shadow 12% for cohorts flagged as critical. Pushing PR to rollout-configs. Assigning @Priya eval job and @Lee dashboard.
Priya: I'll own the contrastive eval harness.
Lee: I'll make the heatmap + daily digest dashboard. Add alert for oscillation pattern (flip-flop within 2 expansions).
Sam: Cool. Dry-run tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Ping if you see oscillation. :eyes:
